library_audit.gap: The information-limit matrix still needs the expected score-Jacobian convergence and resolution of the malformed lower-right B3 entry.

variant_reviews.comparison: For each variance vector theta, xi-hat=(X-transpose V^-1 X)^-1 X-transpose V^-1 y, then subtract one-half log determinant of X-transpose V^-1 X from the profiled working likelihood. This needs full column rank and valid positive covariance; total inverse/log at singular points is not a REML convention. Maximize over theta, then plug back xi-hat and interleave omega_R as printed. No Gaussian truth, uniqueness, root-to-global-maximum theorem or automatic bias removal is asserted by these primitives.

searches.result: Matrix operations express generalized least squares and the profile adjustment, but no REML implementation or optimization theorem was located.

library_audit.gap: The REML estimator still needs invertible covariance/design information and an attained maximum of the exact adjusted profile criterion.

variant_reviews.comparison: Adjustment is independent of regression xi, so mean-score components are unchanged. For each variance v, dV/dv=Z_s Z_s-transpose and derivative of -one-half logdet(X-transpose V^-1 X) contributes plus one-half the displayed trace, whereas all four source corrections have minus signs. Preserve both statements and exact Z1,Z2,Z3,Z0 assignment rather than choosing an intended correction. Generic differentiation/inverse formulas still require a valid smooth domain; direct joint optimization and two-stage profiling do not resolve the score inconsistency.
